item.title: How the Real Linus's Words in the LTT Video Cured My Anxiety
item.description: Although I had seen this widely circulated quote before, I didn’t know its source at the time. Recently, by chance, I learned about LTT and how Linus used AI to fix Linux bugs, mentioning how difficult the process was and how much help he received from AI. Then I happened to come across this video. Although it’s a video from late 2025, the topics discussed in it almost completely dissolved my anxiety about AI and overturned some of my own thinking. item.title: Curating My Music, Preserving My Vibes
item.description: My blog started getting super dry and dull after I began posting more specialized learning content. Seriously, opening it just screamed ‘study time,’ which built up this mental block against writing. I’ve wanted to post other stuff for ages but never got around to it.
